text: The Indian government has launched the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana to provide free electricity to 1 crore households.
India's GDP growth rate for Q3 FY24 was 8.4%.
The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme provides Rs. 6000 per year to eligible farmer families.
The Reserve Bank of India has kept the repo rate unchanged at 6.5% in its February 2024 monetary policy meeting.
Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana provides health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year.
India's foreign exchange reserves reached an all-time high of $642.49 billion in March 2024.
The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) processed over 13 billion transactions in March 2024.
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the Aditya-L1 mission to study the Sun.
The Women's Reservation Bill 2023 reserves 33% of seats in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies for women.
India is the world's most populous country with a population of over 1.4 billion.
The Goods and Services Tax (GST) collection for March 2024 was Rs. 1.78 lakh crore.
The Atal Tunnel is the world's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 feet.
India's literacy rate is approximately 77.7% as per the NSO report.
The Make in India initiative was launched to encourage companies to manufacture their products in India.
The Digital India programme aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
The Swachh Bharat Abhiyan aims to achieve a Clean India by 2019.
The National Education Policy 2020 proposes a 5+3+3+4 curricular structure.
The Startup India initiative aims to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups.
The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme aims to boost domestic manufacturing.
India's renewable energy capacity has crossed 180 GW.
The Vande Bharat Express is India's first semi-high speed train.
The Jal Jeevan Mission aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections by 2024.
The PM Vishwakarma Scheme supports traditional artisans and craftspeople.
India's net direct tax collections grew by 17.7% in FY24.
The e-Shram portal is a national database of unorganized workers.
The PM GatiShakti National Master Plan aims for multi-modal connectivity.
The Agnipath Scheme is a tour of duty style scheme for recruitment of soldiers.
India successfully hosted the G20 Summit in New Delhi in 2023.
The Chandrayaan-3 mission made India the first country to land on the lunar south pole.
The Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) 2019 aims to provide citizenship to persecuted minorities from neighboring countries.
